title: Truchas material
description: A single-phase or multiphase material definition.

phase-name.description: A non-empty phase name. The colon is reserved for phase-change names.

phase-list.title: Material phases
phase-list.description: Named phases ordered by the material factory from low to high temperature using the phase-change sequence.

phase-change-list.title: Material phase changes
phase-change-list.description: Phase changes keyed by an ordered low-temperature:high-temperature phase-name pair.

single-phase-material.title: Single-phase material
single-phase-material.description: A material with one phase and one property/attribute list.

multiphase-material.title: Multiphase material
multiphase-material.description: A material with properties shared across phases, named phase-specific properties, and a connected sequence of phase changes.

properties.description: Optional properties and attributes inherited by every phase unless overridden by a phase-specific value.
